title: The VMM must disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.
check_content:
Verify the VMM is configured to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.

If the VMM is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the VMM to disable accounts when the accounts are no longer associated to a user.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality which reduce the attack surface of the system.
